scientific_names.conclusion: Canonical search makes the 634894 preferred canonical name rows operationally redundant in the cloud runtime; W1 remains unchanged.

external_ids.conclusion: The full external-ID table is duplicate resolver/display storage for this release; future noncanonical mappings belong in an exception table.

concept_alternatives.conclusion: Active IDs live in the active taxon slot; disappeared IDs are retained only when referenced or retired, backed by immutable W1 artifacts and W3 snapshots.

field_width_analysis.decision: Dictionary-code low-cardinality rank, source, language, family, and status values. Genus has 181312 distinct values, so its dictionary saves less and is retained only because measured Candidate C still passes.

index_overlap_analysis.overlap: left prefix of authoritative unique index

A_minimally_optimized_w2a.transformation: All W2A rows and decomposition retained; three proven overlapping indexes omitted; literal escaped LIKE prefix predicates.

B_compact_active_slot.transformation: Text release_id replaced by smallint slot; W2A decomposition and runtime rows retained; legacy namespace-lost rows kept offline; overlapping indexes omitted.

C_purpose_built_compact.transformation: Compact active taxon display/resolver row; 27755 true aliases only; vernaculars with language dictionary; zero external-ID exceptions; compact Red List; immutable release metadata and active pointer.
C_purpose_built_compact.omissions_preserved_in: immutable W1 artifact, release manifest/evidence; active IDs in taxa; future referenced/retired identity registry and W3 observation snapshots
C_purpose_built_compact.semantic_outcome: pass for accepted release and contract probes

candidate_schema_definitions.A: W2A decomposition with release text keys; retain constraint indexes and search indexes; omit only three proven left-prefix duplicates; use escaped LIKE predicates.
candidate_schema_definitions.B: release metadata plus smallint slot; concepts(id); taxa; all scientific names; all vernaculars; all authoritative mappings; compact slot-key indexes; Red List; namespace-lost legacy IDs offline.
candidate_schema_definitions.C: publication(slot smallint, release_id, hashes, status); active_publication(singleton, slot); rank/source/language/family dictionaries; taxa(slot,id,parent,genus/display,epithet,family,canonical_name,rank,source,canonical_external_id); scientific_aliases(slot,id,name,preferred); vernacular_names(slot,id,language,name,preferred); external_id_exceptions(slot,id,source,namespace,external_id,role,preferred); redlist(slot,id,area,assessment,category,flags,criteria,url). Bulk tables are list-partitioned by slot in W2D.

publication_peak_experiment.finding: DELETE plus ordinary VACUUM does not reclaim the slot footprint. W2D must use independently truncatable/list-partitioned slot storage; truncate/detach only the inactive retired partition after activation.

performance.explain_summary: All probes used c_taxa_name, c_alias_name, c_vernacular_name, or c_taxa_resolver. Cold selective probes read 2-18 shared blocks; warm probes read zero blocks; temporary blocks were zero; rows removed by filter were zero.

identity_history_analysis.stable_id: Immutable positive sporely_taxon_id remains the primary runtime identity and is never merged by name.
identity_history_analysis.disappeared_taxa: Immutable W1 artifacts retain every release. A small historical identity registry gains rows only for IDs referenced by observations or retired from the active release.
identity_history_analysis.observation_history: W3 snapshots must preserve ID, displayed name, authoritative source/ID, and release ID; no retired full search slot is needed for historical display.
identity_history_analysis.rollback: Keep previous slot until the rollback window ends. Pointer rollback is atomic. Only then truncate/detach the inactive retired slot.
identity_history_analysis.security: W2D must enable RLS with no direct client policies and expose controlled SECURITY DEFINER RPCs with an empty/fixed search_path.
identity_history_analysis.redlist: Norge/Svalbard remain separate. Production publication is independently blocked on provenance/licensing.
